The oven works fine now. Remember when measuring the element that the dimension includes the amount that sticks through the back of the oven. I got confused when only looking at the part that you can see in the oven. I pulled the element legs out with the wires attached and used clothes pins to hold the wires from retracting. This way you dont have to open the back of the oven. You may have to bend the tabs on the ends of the element to align the wires. There is a little smoke when you first energize the element, but it quickly stops. Remember to unplug the stove before working on it. Pulling the stove out gives you a reason to clean the years of grease off the sides of the stove and get the dust bunnies out from under.
Great price
Didn't completely fit but seems to with with modification.

I would give 4.5 stars if I could. The part was delivered quickly and was the right part, except note below. It was quite easy to install, just be careful because the clips from the oven wiring to the element can fall behind the back wall of the oven once disconnected from the old element if you aren't careful, and would be difficult to retrieve; and the replacement element had connectors bent at a right angle to the element which should be no big deal but once the wires were connected it was a bit of a struggle to get the connectors back through the rather small openings in the back of the oven. The old element had straight connectors, which fit through easily. I was hesitant to bend the connectors. I might be a little afraid of the wires popping off trying to pull them back through the holes again because of the tight fit, should I ever have to replace the element again. Not sure how I can rate longevity of the replacement element. It's lasted a week so far!
Good price and service
The old burner went out just before family was to come visit. This arrived timely and was easy to install. And we had am great visit.
works like should

It replaced my old that just cracked all to pieces.  Works like a charm.  Cut power at the breaker, verified power was off at the stove, unscrewed tabs on both sides and a swapped tabs on end of elements and reverse actions from here.  First time doing it.

Handle broke after only two weeks.  Flawed design and replacement handle is constructed worse than the original.  I wound up threading a piece of nylon rope through the holes on the dryer door and it will likely last forever.  Not the prettiest solution but very effective and permanent.

ORIGINAL REVIEW: My dryer was 11 years old the first time I had to replace the handle. This one is almost identical to the 1st replacement. It's not the same exact color, but I really don't care about the color of it. This one also feels a little thinner than the 1st replacement handle, so I'm worried it won't last. Also, when it arrived it had no rubber padding on the backside, so not as comfortable to pull on it. I had to look online for instructions on how to replace the old one, but once I got those, the whole process took about 20 mins. I hope it lasts at least a couple of years.

UPDATE 5/4/15: I'm changing my review from 3 to 1 star. The original handle lasted 10 years. The 2nd one lasted 2 years. This one, the 3rd, only lasted 1.5 years. Obviously not OEM by any means, and I was correct in saying it probably wouldn't last. My dryer is now 15 years old and still works great, except for this handle issue. I ended up using some black duct tape to hold it on. That's working pretty well, actually. Sure, I had to use a few pieces, but it's fine for now. Considering the age of the washer and dryer, and that I plan to move this year, I won't be taking these units with me. I don't plan to replace the handle again before I leave. I guess I shouldn't have been so cheap, but as I thought I'd be moving last year, I really didn't care.
The original lasted 8 years. This was a good looking replacement that fit perfectly and installed easily. But it broke after about 5 loads... What to try now...?
Take out all the screws inside the door to install. Note that some screws are different sizes. Takes about ten minutes.

After looking up in you tube on how to repair this handle, I am embarrased that it was so easy and let my struggle with opening the door for the past year or so.  the part fit perfectly and as quick as I could unscrew a handful of screws, it as long as it took me to replace this broken handle.

The trouble with reviews on Amazon is that they can cover multiple variations of the same product. These can be different items (even if they are called the same thing) and/or the items come from multiple suppliers.

Installed March 2014 and no problems with it. I was not the person who broke the original one that I was replacing, but I can see how this part can be stressed if you apply force in the wrong places or angles when opening the door. Complaints from other buyers about this replacement handle breaking are more likely due to the basic design of the part and/or the usage habits of the machine owners. There's nothing suspicious in my view about the quality of the manufacture of this part itself, it is what it is. I have seen elsewhere a metal replacement handle available for considerably more cost and less availability. If you're breaking this handle on a recurring basis, that extra expenditure and effort to acquire might be worth it. Otherwise, this part works as it is supposed to.

As many reviews have stated, the replacement dryer door handle also cracked and eventually broke off (after about 1 year) in a similar manner as the original.  Rather than ordering another piece of poorly engineered plastic, I took the recommendation to get the USA-made replacement handle manufactured from Ohio Solutions and Design.  Sure, it is about twice the price but it is a beautifully crafted, exact replica, perfectly fitting, high strength, solid aluminum handle for Kenmore Elite dryers.  It also came with the attached inner surface rubber padding.  I am totally satisfied with my decision!
